descriptions.event-sourcing: Start with the fundamentals, then move through modelling, business logic, projections, testing, evolution, and the situations where Event Sourcing is the wrong choice.
descriptions.event-driven-architecture: A practical path through distributed processes, delivery guarantees, idempotency, ordering, concurrency, and rebuilding read models safely.
descriptions.cqrs: Learn what CQRS is without the usual ceremony, then see commands, read models, and consistency trade-offs in practical examples.
descriptions.architecture: Pragmatic modelling and architecture guidance: understand the problem, expose assumptions, draw useful boundaries, and keep ownership explicit.
